verbose.description: Enable verbose output for diagnostic tools (e.g., show device details, command details).

default_timeout.description: Default timeout (in seconds) for SCSI commands executed by tools like sg_scan and sdparm. Set to 0 for no timeout.

device_rules.description: List of per-device rules to control how SCSI generic devices are scanned or used. Rules are evaluated in order.

dev_node.description: Device node path (e.g., /dev/sda, /dev/sg2) to match. Supports glob patterns like /dev/sd*.

skip.description: If true, skip this device entirely (do not expose it to sg3-utils tools).

timeout.description: Per-device timeout (in seconds). Overrides the global default_timeout for this device only.

comment.description: Optional human-readable comment describing this rule.

no_auto.description: If true, disable automatic scanning of /dev/sg* nodes. Useful when using multipath or custom discovery logic.
